input_data.reference: src/geodesic-sycl/locations.txt (DVC, md5 03ce97e6d0c09f8be45907295e5d78c4, 42873157 bytes), symlinked by geodesic-cuda/hip/omp
input_data.port_default: deterministic built-in xorshift64* generator (seed 12345) so the port is self-contained
input_data.port_override: --input <file> reads the exact HeCBench lat/lon format; used in validation

timing_scope: repeat back-to-back kernel enqueues between two synchronisations / repeat; warmup excluded; host reference and validation outside the timed region
validation_tolerance: |got-ref| <= 1e-6 km + 1e-9*|ref|; justified: device and double host both evaluate the same double expression, differing only by libm ULP (order 1e-12 km at 1e4 km distances)

cross_check_reference_binary.method: same synthetic 2^21 input file fed to both the pinned reference binary and the alpaka port; device distance arrays compared elementwise

reference_commands.cuda_ref: nvcc -std=c++17 -Xcompiler -Wall -arch=sm_70 -O3 -use_fast_math main.cu distance.cu -o hav_cuda_ref; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 ./hav_cuda_ref locations.txt 100
reference_commands.omp_ref_hostpar: g++ -O2 -fopenmp -std=c++17 -Wall main_timed.cpp distance_hostpar.cpp -o hav_omp_timed_o2; OMP_NUM_THREADS=14 ./hav_omp_timed_o2 locations.txt 20
reference_commands.alpaka_cuda: cmake --preset rel-cuda-nvcc-gcc -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=70 -Dalpaka_COMPILE_PEDANTIC=ON -Dalpaka_BUILD_BENCHMARKS=ON .; cmake --build build/rel-cuda-nvcc-gcc --target haversine_alpaka -j; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 ./build/rel-cuda-nvcc-gcc/benchmark/haversine/haversine_alpaka --input locations.txt --repeat 100 --samples 7
reference_commands.alpaka_cpu: cmake --preset rel-host-cpu-gcc -Dalpaka_COMPILE_PEDANTIC=ON -Dalpaka_BUILD_BENCHMARKS=ON .; cmake --build build/rel-host-cpu-gcc --target haversine_alpaka -j; OMP_NUM_THREADS=14 ./build/rel-host-cpu-gcc/benchmark/haversine/haversine_alpaka --input locations.txt --repeat 20 --samples 7

reference_cpu_note: The HeCBench haversine-omp source wraps the loop in an OpenMP target-offload region that g++ cannot compile and icpx/nvc are absent, so the CPU baseline is the same source with the offload pragma replaced by a plain host parallel-for (14 threads). The pinned reference main.cu's own host verification loop was also timed sequentially (1 thread) as a second baseline.
model_detail: rosi_v100 unreachable during the whole task; used fwk394 (Quadro GV100, SM 7.0, driver 555.52.04, CUDA 12.5 V12.5.82, g++ 13.2.0, host Intel Xeon W-2175, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1).
